findings.msg: spills out of [wordmark]: a thing holds what is in it (ledger L37)
the wordmark is transformed: it is never transformed, shadowed, outlined, stroked, filtered, faded or moved (C1)
has a fill of rgb(242, 242, 242), which is not a color in tokens.css: use var(--token)
is a [count] that looks pressable: a tag, a count or a countdown is not a button
is only black, white and gray, with no color ground and no photo: it will read as no brand (ledger L2)
is not drawn in the states new, empty, one, typical, dense, failed, offline: draw each, or say why it can't happen with data-skip="new: why"
has a --card-edge line: color is a ground, never a line. Lines are the hairline, ink or brick (Art. 5.1)
